method: Complete candidate survey followed by individual editorial choices and written reasons. All verified authorized selections included. Priority given to foundational teachings, substantive explanations, necessary qualifications, distinctive applications, narrative examples and thematic breadth across grace, confirmation and spiritual capacity. Neither citation count nor source order used as a ranking rule. Imported wording checked separately; version differences remain explicit.

selected.text: If all good deeds were to proceed from someone yet not be adorned with the ornament of divine acceptance, it would be absolute nothingness and sheer non-existence, and no fruit would appear from those good deeds - how much more so with matters that cause harm to the Cause and the aversion of people and lead to sedition and corruption.
selected.reason: Good deeds without divine acceptance are sheer nothingness.

selected.text: However much the powerful rays of the sun may melt an iron object and render fluid what was once solid, it cannot make the frozen heart perceive, nor bring delight to the deprived blind. And however much the melodies of the divine nightingale may bestow happiness and evoke ecstasy, they cannot make those with defective hearing grow wise.
selected.reason: The sun can melt iron yet cannot make a frozen heart perceive: the limits set by capacity.

selected.text: What capacity has an atom to receive the bounty of the sun, and what power has a tiny bird to soar to the heights of an eagle? What merit has a dried plant to find freshness and delicacy in this rose garden and become a fruitful tree? But the grace of the Glorious Lord is immense and the bounty of the Ancient Lord is like an all-encompassing ocean.
selected.reason: An atom has no capacity for the sun, yet the grace of the Lord is immense.

selected.text: The mercy is universal and the bounty all-encompassing, but universality does not prevent specificity. Among His servants are those whom God has distinguished with a matter that sets them apart from others - namely the homeland of the Most Great Light and nearness in the shadow of relation to the Ancient Beauty. He specially favors with His mercy whomever He wishes.
selected.reason: Universal mercy does not exclude special favour.

selected.text: Many souls spent years in worship, acquired knowledge, became versed in arts and sciences, passed their time in contemplation, and yearned for mystical revelations. Yet despite this, as their intentions were not pure, they remained deprived and were defeated in the arena of divine knowledge. But when God gazed upon your hearts, He found them pure pages and made them luminous
selected.reason: Years of worship and learning avail nothing without pure intention; grace looks upon the heart.

selected.text: Those souls who possess the capacity to receive the outpourings of the Kingdom and are qualified to obtain the confirmations of the Holy Spirit become attracted through a single word. But those souls who lack capacity, no matter how much thou mayest explain the divine counsels and advice to them, and no matter how much the breeze of the Holy Spirit may waft, it will produce no effect; rather, it will only increase their frozenness and heedlessness.
selected.reason: Souls with capacity are attracted by a single word; without capacity no explanation suffices.

selected.text: For example we observe that the Divine Grace like the rain pours down upon the Earth - Now if this rain falls upon brackish ground nothing will grow for the soil lacks the power of producing vegetation - as long as there is not the capacity in the soil no matter how much the rain may fall on it, it will yield no result … Therefore no matter how great is the Divine Grace yet if a man is not endowed with capability to receive it, there is no results
selected.reason: Rain on brackish ground: divine grace yields fruit only where there is capacity.

selected.text: and assist to elevate woman to her true dignity and station. Such as you find in this lamp--the oil and the wick--the power to ignite it. selected.text: In the depths of the sea there are a hundred thousand shells, but all are empty save the shell which is the recipient of divine bounty and is adorned and filled with the precious pearl of guidance. selected.reason: Countless shells, but only the one receiving bounty holds the pearl of guidance.

importedAuthorityReview.authorization: Authorized prayer paragraph1, with one omitted word and capitalization differences preserved.
importedAuthorityReview.finding: Compared BH10505 version 1873dc11ab4963a548e1b86b1ac602fd0344b05f6c774ae48aa8305967c965b2 paragraph1, metadata Y. The authorized prayer reads O God! Leave them not to themselves, but guide their steps by the light of Thy knowledge, and cheer their hearts by Thy love. The supplied wording agrees except that it omits Thy before knowledge and capitalizes Knowledge and Love. Include conservatively for the authorized sentence without adopting the omission, and preserve approximate status.

importedAuthorityReview.authorization: Authorized paragraph2 wording joined to an unauthorized salutation.
importedAuthorityReview.finding: Compared AB12015 version 39217bc2921ad3319dfbc066da312519dafb362c177986b7315fbec50b20d0b6, metadata Y2-3. The supplied words by the grace and favour of God, he may meet with success agree exactly with authorized paragraph2, which the Social Action compilation on the linked official page gives as extract 204, beginning Since thy dear child is taking his examinations. The salutation O seeker after confirmation is paragraph1, outside the authorized range, and the ellipsis hides that the success hoped for is a child's examinations. Include conservatively for the authorized words and preserve approximate status.

importedAuthorityReview.authorization: Different rendering of authorized paragraph4; supplied wording not authorized.
importedAuthorityReview.finding: Compared AB03757 version 58b1c6f422b730c67afb58b85f78880dcd8a2c1946f44913b66d78adba112202 paragraph4, metadata Y4. The authorized wording reads Then will thy speech, through the confirmation of the Holy Spirit, stir every heart; the supplied At that time thy speech will take effect within the hearts is a different, probably historical, rendering. Omit as a short variant; no authority transferred.

importedAuthorityReview.authorization: Different rendering of authorized paragraph7; supplied wording not authorized.
importedAuthorityReview.finding: Compared AB04980 version 447d1bebc0097bdd70f2386ecd65e427e981bdfe6d11a44af0e1dd1cc1194758 paragraph7, metadata Y5,7. The authorized prayer reads brighten my eyes by beholding the hosts of divine assistance descending successively upon me from the kingdom of Thine omnipotent glory; the supplied illumine my sight with seeing the hosts of success following one another is a different, probably historical, translation. Omit; no authority transferred.

importedAuthorityReview.authorization: Paragraph5 has no authorization; the opening clause is a different rendering of authorized paragraph4.
importedAuthorityReview.finding: Compared AB01339 version c91071542bfb11be732b47814ac0617f28e61f0c39e6228a6b776592d6a2c10c, metadata Y4. The supplied second part agrees with paragraph5, which lies outside the authorized range. The opening Grant me spiritual power and light the lamp of guidance in the glass of my heart differs from authorized paragraph4, Bestow upon me heavenly power, and kindle the lamp of the spirit within the innermost chamber of my heart. Omit; no authority transferred.

importedAuthorityReview.authorization: Different rendering of authorized paragraph3; supplied wording not authorized.
importedAuthorityReview.finding: Compared BH05162 version f3ff54abddde3f96ea664e4544efa4b5b0f7a36e0dd9643026adbe48bffe9ff0 paragraph3, metadata Y3-5, cited as Gleanings CLVII. The authorized wording reads They that have forsaken their country for the purpose of teaching Our Cause, and A company of Our chosen angels; the supplied homes, the Cause and His chosen angels are a different rendering. Omit; the promise of angelic assistance to those who arise is carried by selected passages.

integrationReview.decision: Keep the existing treatment of receptivity and surrender of one’s will; the new stone analogy largely repeats the capacity distinction.
